title: Voter Registration Readiness Overdue Aging by Status
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=voter:registration
| eval days_overdue=round((now()-election_deadline_epoch)/86400,1)
| where days_overdue>0
| stats avg(days_overdue) as avg_days_overdue max(days_overdue) as max_days_overdue count as items by registration_status
| sort - avg_days_overdue
description: Measures how long overdue voter registration readiness work is staying stuck in each status.
value: Aging by status shows whether the bottleneck is waiting on you, a vendor, a family member, or missing paperwork.
implementation: Review this weekly and tighten the workflow stage that owns the oldest overdue records.
visualization: Bar chart of average overdue days by status.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers where overdue voter records are getting stuck instead of moving to done.
